title: Compose file with OrcaCD settings
description: The Compose specification with the x-orcacd extension, which sets the OrcaCD settings of the application.

duration.description: A duration like "30s", "5m", "1h30m" or "7d", or a number of seconds.

release-age.description: The minimum release age of the image of this service, at most 365d. The global minimum still applies when it is higher.

orcacd.description: OrcaCD settings of the application. Settings set here can't be changed in OrcaCD, removing them restores their default.

image-poll.description: Checks the registries for newer images and redeploys the application when one changed. true or false is short for enabled.

interval.description: How often to check, at least 1m. Defaults to 2m.

delete-old-images.description: Deletes images that are no longer used after an update.

rollback.description: Rolls back to the previous deployment automatically. true or false is short for enabled.

on-deploy-failure.description: Roll back when the deployment fails.

on-unhealthy.description: Roll back when the deployment doesn't become healthy within the health timeout.

health-timeout.description: How long a deployment may take to become healthy, between 30s and 1h. Defaults to 5m.

pause-auto-sync.description: Pause automatic syncs after a rollback, so they don't undo it.

release-age.description: Holds back image updates until the new image was pushed long enough ago.

minimum.description: The minimum release age, at most 365d. null uses the global one, which also applies when it is higher.

allowed-registries.description: Registry hosts like registry.example.com:5000 whose images skip the minimum release age.
